name: @dharmax/codebase-parser
description: Universal, lightweight, and fast multi-language codebase parser for symbols, facts, and notes.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.mjs --target=node --format=esm --outdir=dist --entry-naming=index.mjs --sourcemap=external && tsc src/index.mjs --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --allowJs

author: dharmax
